column1: # Immortals Fenyx Rising (Ubisoft), base game 1.3.4, Ubisoft's Anvil engine on NVN with Havok and Wwise, SDK 10.4.0.
# Profile made from a survey of the user's own .nup (read in place, no extraction); bring-up and on-device validation are still open. See README.md.
# main imports only from sdk (no subsdk on this build).
# From the survey: the NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets
# a heap, so the game maps its memory itself in a 4.375 GB alias region; refine these on a real boot.
# All NVN programs are in the root ShaderDataNVN.bin: repeated GPUCODEONLY code-only blobs whose control
# sections pair with the code area ending four bytes before each (graphics headed, compute headerless).
